The '''Council of Elders''' was a ruling body in the former [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] government. After the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Alderaanian weapons were placed onboard the [[Alderaanian War Frigate|war]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Another Chance]]'', which was later sent on a random voyage throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], until the Council activated the ships' recall beacon in a time of emergency. But the Council never had the chance. The council was destroyed when the first [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|wiped out]] Alderaan; however, the beacon would survive to be used. [[Orinn Tathis]] was the last surviving member of the Council, having been off-world at the time of Alderaan's destruction.
